name: Synthecyte
description1: In deep space, Synthecyte fuse together to form a single, massive organism. Together, they travel through the cosmos, feeding on the energy of stars and planets.
description2: Its DNA is highly adaptable, allowing it to merge with other lifeforms. It seeks out strong species to assimilate, using their power to further its own evolution.

name: Fawnna
description1: Incredibly timid, Fawnna hide deep within dense bamboo and copihue groves. If they sense danger, they freeze completely, hoping the flower buds on their heads blend into the brush.
description2: The twin buds on its head absorb solar energy to keep it warm. When it feels completely safe around its Trainer, the buds emit a soft, comforting glow and a sweet, calming scent.

name: Fawliage
description1: Having grown more confident, Fawliage actively patrols its territory. It wears a thick poncho of leaves that acts as a solar panel, channeling energy into its rapidly growing wooden antlers.
description2: It takes immense pride in its appearance, spending hours grooming its foliage. It practices martial discipline by using its bark-covered rear legs to deliver precise, swift kicks against tree trunks.

name: Dynastag
description1: With an air of absolute nobility, Dynastag rules over its forest domain. It uses its hardened wooden cane with the flawless grace of a master fencer, deflecting enemy attacks with a single, effortless parry.
description2: When it shakes its elegant, ornate antlers, the delicate bell-flowers ring out a rhythmic chime. This sound relaxes allies, but to its enemies, it is the chilling signal that a duel has begun.

name: Pumace
description1: It inhabits arid badlands and volcanic crags, using the dark, ash-colored fur on its face to shield its eyes from intense desert sun glare. It tracks prey patiently through clouds of dust.
description2: Highly alert, Pumace constantly monitors shifting geothermal currents beneath its paws. If cornered, it beats its tail against the parched earth to create a blinding smokescreen of ash.

name: Pyroncho
description1: The thick poncho around its neck is formed from compressed stone that perfectly insulates its intense internal heat. Volcanic vents protruding from its back constantly billow out heavy smoke to conceal its presence.
description2: It keeps its front paws hidden beneath its heavy coat, making its quick-striking embers completely unpredictable. It uses the sharp, brim-like fur on its head to shield its eyes from falling volcanic ash.

name: Smoldero
description1: Known as the lawless apex of the volcanic plains, Smoldero commands absolute authority with a menacing glare. The three whip-like tails on its back hold superheated obsidian stones that it hurls with lethal, pinpoint accuracy.
description2: Its stone-like greaves are formed from layers of cooled, hardened magma, protecting its legs during high-speed pursuits. Its glowing, fiery fangs can melt through solid iron, leaving molten scorch marks on anything it bites.

name: Sealor
description1: It wears a star-shaped mark on its chest with immense pride, eagerly following the orders of older, more experienced Pokémon.
description2: Despite its clumsy movements on land, it diligently salutes with its flippers to show respect. The thick white fur on its head keeps it warm in freezing ocean currents.

name: Enseal
description1: Known for its strict discipline, it commands its pod with crisp, sharp barks. The yellow band around its neck acts as a biological flotation device during turbulent storms.
description2: It stands at attention on jagged coastal rocks, constantly surveying the ocean for signs of danger. Its sleek blue body is built to navigate treacherous waters with ease.

name: Brigantide
description1: A legendary commander of the seas, its heavy, steel claws can shred through the hulls of ships. The iron plating on its chest acts as an impenetrable breastplate against enemy attacks.
description2: It governs massive pods of Sealor and Enseal with unyielding strictness, communicating complex tactical formations through deep, rumbling barks. To withstand extreme deep-sea pressure, it continuously absorbs iron from the ocean floor to naturally harden its body.

name: Panacha
description1: Its long, upright ears mimic the shape of wheat stalks to blend into tall grass. It spends hours resting in the harsh sun, allowing its starchy saliva coating to form a light, protective crust over its fur.
description2: A highly relaxed Pokémon native to rocky foothills. It mixes wild grains with mineral-rich volcanic soil in its cheek pouches to create a thick dough paste, which it uses to reinforce its burrow against predators.

name: Marracacha
description1: The massive, deep-grooved loaf of bread on its back acts as a rock-hard shield. When threatened, it tucks its body tightly beneath this heavy armor and rolls edge-over-edge like a runaway millstone to flatten enemies.
description2: The white dust on its face is actually an incredibly fine, dry mountain clay. It uses its internal body heat to kiln-bake its dense shell, venting out hot, yeasty-smelling steam from small indentations along its back when it exerts itself.

name: Grismirk
description1: It picks fights with Pokémon far bigger than itself and wears a smug grin the whole time. The tougher the opponent, the more it seems to enjoy the scrap.
description2: It hides in the thorny brush of the dry hills, darting out to nip at larger Pokémon before scampering off. Trainers know it by its cheeky gold-eyed smirk.

name: Grimson
description1: It puffs its pale mane up around its head like a hood before a battle. It never backs down from a bigger foe, and it wins far more often than its size suggests.
description2: Quick, clever, and full of nerve, it thrives on being underestimated. It loves nothing more than toppling an opponent twice its size and strutting off.

name: Cackloon
description1: They have uniquely evolved to resemble a human head to frighten others. They are said to lure travelers to their doom by mimicking human laughter.
description2: Cackloon enjoy mimicking human laughter, and will often gather in groups to cackle together. To avoid being attacked by Cackloon, it is best to join in on their revelry.

name: Necrondor
description1: Necrondor are long-lived and their bones are said to grant eternal life. Many ancient funerary sites are said to be guarded by Necrondor, who will attack anyone who tries to steal from them.
description2: Its tattered wings protect it from the chilling winds of the mountains they call home. They stand still for hours, watching the land with their hypnotic gaze.

name: Peppilla
description1: Peppilla curl around their own tail to mimic ripening peppers, hiding among crops in mountain fields. Farmers consider one in the harvest a sign of a flavorful year.
description2: Its body builds up a fiery oil as it feeds. Predators that bite a Peppilla are met with a searing taste they never forget.

name: Peppyre
description1: Peppyre seals itself in a hardened shell and slowly smolders from within, curing its own body like a smoked pepper. The plume rising from its back carries a rich, spicy aroma for miles.
description2: It barely moves while its inner fire dries and toughens its shell. Mountain villagers once gathered the fragrant ash it sheds to season their food.

name: Pepperisher
description1: Pepperisher scatters burning spice from its wings as it flies, said to be the ground remains of its old shell. A single flake on the tongue can leave a person breathless for days.
description2: Its bleached mask is the husk of its pupal shell. It descends silently on those who steal from pepper fields, leaving nothing behind but a scorching haze.

name: Sedimental-Dormant
description1: Rain is so scarce in the desert where Sedimental live that many go their entire lives without opening their petals. Tourists will gather in the rain to see such a rare sight.
description2: Its said that Sedimental is the reincarnation of two lovers who were tragically separated. It constantly searches for its better half, crying in the desert rain.

name: Sedimental-Bloom
description1: Rain is so scarce in the desert where Sedimental live that many go their entire lives without opening their petals. Tourists will gather in the rain to see such a rare sight.
description2: Its said that Sedimental is the reincarnation of two lovers who were tragically separated. It constantly searches for its better half, crying in the desert rain.

name: Amistaphore
description1: Its spores have a calming effect on those around it, making them lose the will to fight. Too much exposure can lead to losing one's memory and sense of self.
description2: Amistaphore lets off minor radio signals that can reach across the region. People and Pokémon who are sensitive to the signals are drawn to Amistaphore and will feel a sense of calm and happiness when near it.
